images.caption: U.S. Navy Senior Chief Culinary Specialist Guy Gagui, left, does a traditional dance with a government employee in Siau, Indonesia, June 5, 2012, during Pacific Partnership 2012. Pacific Partnership is an annual deployment of forces designed to strengthen maritime and humanitarian partnerships during disaster relief operations, while providing humanitarian, medical, dental and engineering assistance to nations of the Pacific. (DoD photo by Mass Communication Specialist 3rd Class Laurie Dexter, U.S. Navy/Released)
